name: BH Co., Ltd.
summary: BH Co., Ltd. engages in the fabrication and distribution of flexible printed circuit boards (FPCBs) along with their complementary components. These versatile circuits are essential for a wide array of modern technologies, including mobile phones, laptops, televisions, gaming systems, automotive display screens, virtual reality devices, in-vehicle wireless phone chargers, and power packs for electric vehicles. The firm was founded in 1999 and maintains its principal operations in Incheon, South Korea.
